# Cloud Migration Architect Skill

> **Category:** Domain Skills

## Overview

Use when designing target cloud architecture, networking, security, and data migration strategy for cloud migration.

## Quick Start

1. Copy this skill folder to your workspace under `.github/skills/`
2. Reference in agent files: `skills: [cloud-migration-architect-skill]`
3. The skill activates automatically when the agent is invoked

## Structure

```text
cloud-migration-architect-skill/
  SKILL.md    # Skill definition with procedures and standards
  GUIDE.md    # This guide
```

## Companion Agent

This skill is designed to work with the `@cloud-migration-architect` agent from the Independent Agents catalogue.

## Key Capabilities

- Evaluate compliance posture against regulatory frameworks (SOC2, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS)
- Assess control effectiveness through evidence collection and gap analysis
- Detect policy violations and configuration drift from security baselines
- Generate audit findings with severity classification and remediation guidance

## Industry Standards Applied

- **Well-Architected Framework**: Cloud architecture pillars: security, reliability, performance, cost, operations
- **12-Factor App**: Methodology for building cloud-native, scalable services
- **CIS Benchmarks**: Security configuration baselines for cloud platforms
